Hi Graham,

I came across your work through the Long Island author community and was struck by your path from the Long Island Reads nomination for Sakhalin to the interplanetary world of Gileon, with Science Commander Von and Xet racing to save their planet.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Gileon is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, built around the planetary rescue at the heart of the story. This is purely an optional add-on to the feature, and there is no pressure at all.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Gileon best?

Warm regards,
